summary: Review actual product behavior against original outcomes
description: Strengthen author/critic proof selection and result review so tests, runtime/browser/visual/audio evidence establish the requested behavior; build on v0.3.33 readiness and existing R# completion. Scope and mandate: .go/plans/autonomy-first.json. Reuse released ABC/advice/readiness behavior; implement only this delta.
acceptance: Carry exact applicable product goals, architecture references and original R# to a fresh read-only critic context. Explain applicability; do not require architecture ceremony or visual evidence for unrelated tiny changes.

Reject preparation documents substituted for delivered behavior, stale screenshots/results, unreproduced fixes and unsupported completion claims even when structural validation and unrelated tests pass.

Each relevant check/result binds task, requirement, candidate/context and inspected source/artifact. Changed relevant content invalidates proof. Pair good/bad realistic examples and record grounded review, not a semantic pass boolean inferred from keywords.

Failed behavioral review returns bounded actionable repair within original scope. Do not rewrite acceptance to manufacture green or require downstream publication receipts in the pre-publication critic.

Complete this independently shippable stack change with content-bound checks/critic, scoped commit/push, immutable release and remote readback; preserve user dirt and historical evidence. Current request authorizes planning only; no execution or publication starts during intake.
verification: uv run --no-project --python 3.12 --with 'pytest>=8,<9' --with 'jsonschema>=4.23' python -m pytest tests/test_autonomy_outcomes.py tests/test_abc_completion.py tests/test_task_design_readiness.py -q -p no:cacheprovider
